featured_reviews.name: Radhika Butala
featured_reviews.review_text: DO NOT BUY AN APPLE PRODUCT from this store. If u really have to then stick to any cheap brands here. They con the customers with sales deals and beat offers and then when it comes to billing they say Oh the offer is not valid. Now either u succumb and accept and pay them higher or insist. If you insist they will make you wait for hours endlessly that u will get frustrated by the item without the offer or leave. The Staff does not share all information at one go but in piece meal. I have come to this store thrice to buy an apple air - the first time was my research. The second time i came to buy it. The sales man Me Devesh Valmiki showed me the details i finalised the product he shared the pricing and i finalised it. Then he asked me to wait for 5 minutes for billing. I waited for 30 minutes after that and he seemed to be busy. I politely said its getting late and i will come the next day as he is busy. I come back today, the store now says the pricing has changed! I insist based kn the experience and ask for the store manager. I have been at this store for 1 hour now but Mr Ajay Dube does not have the time. A deputy from another department Mr Vikas tries to help. He comes back and says he will extend the manages discount to match the price offered. When i go to bill they claim - no discount possible today the system isnt accepting! I have wasted and hour yesterday and now an hour today. This has been such a shitty experience. This brand does not care about its customers. They should not be selling products like APPLE.

featured_reviews.name: Hoornur Hashmi
featured_reviews.review_text:
There is a salesman here called Priyanka Gupta - who is way too rude and condescending. I had gone here with my husband to buy a refrigerator. Me and my husband were discussing the features. When we asked her questions she didn’t know any of the answers- she was making up  features and when we checked the specifications found out that she was just lying. We asked her about any discounts available and she said “No” at first. We then saw that there was an offer of free appliance and also discounts if you buy appliances of certain prices. We asked her very politely about how much discount we can get. She in turn started teaching us maths and said “what is 10% of this- don’t you know calculations? Then calculate it yourself na.”She even made fun of us and said, “Looks like you are brain is very sharp.” And started laughing after that. If we ask questions we expect sales rep to answer them instead Of making fun of us or being rude. She seemed only interested in selling big price products and she seemed very reluctant to discuss any offers and discounts. We both decided to buy the same appliance from Chroma which is a little further away.
Hope they train their sales reps on customer service skills.

featured_reviews.review_text: We had a great experience with Sona & Bhagyashree at Reliance Digital, Prabhadevi. She assisted us with purchasing an AC, refrigerator, and washing machine, and the entire process was smooth and well-managed. She was knowledgeable, patient, and helped us choose the right products as per our requirements. Truly appreciate her prompt support and professionalism.

featured_reviews.name: wheretonext
featured_reviews.review_text:
Firstly don't force customer to write a review after purchasing a product when you sell faulty products. The service from Reliance has been absolutely horrible. I was earlier in touch with Alifya for an AC issue and when she went on leave I had to deal with ISMAIL— hands down the most unprofessional person i haveever spoken to.
It’s been over two weeks (since 8th October) and the issue is still not fixed. Every time I call, I get excuses and attitude. Ismail keeps saying he’ll send someone, but no one shows up. Yesterday, when I completely lost it after seeing the condition of the house, he had the audacity to back answer and disconnect the call. And when I said I’d complain to the police, he said, “Kardo.” Like seriously? Is this how Reliance trains their staff to talk to customers? You people push us to the edge with your horrible service and then act like we’re the problem.
When I asked to speak to a senior, he said “I’m the only one here.” What kind of joke is this? This guy doesn’t even sound like a trainee, forget being a senior.. doesn't understand basic English or Hindi properly. And the way he talks — zero manners. He was even laughing while I was clearly frustrated. Such arrogance and lack of basic manners are shocking. Has Reliance really fallen this low?  It’s disappointing to see a reputed company employing people who neither communicate properly nor show any understanding of customer service.
When the technician showed up yesterday (Friday) and guess what — he had no idea what the actual issue was. We had to tellhim the issue first. I had already told Ismail not to do any drilling because our interiors are done, but he still sent a guy who wanted to do some pipe fitting and ended up messing up our furniture and sitting area with some black dirt. During Diwali, when we had just cleaned the house. I’ve attached pictures. Half of it my mom had already cleaned before me reaching home. This what your technicians do when they visit every time.
This isn’t even the first time. The last time your team came for installation, they were spitting pan on our grill — we had to clean it ourselves. I didn’t complain then, but now it’s just too much. our AC doesn’t even look new anymore. Your so called “technicians” have spoiled it completely.
